SELECT
    p.party_type,
    p.statewide_vehicle_type,
    p.party_safety_equipment_1,
    p.party_safety_equipment_2,
    COUNT(*) AS party_rows
FROM main.parties AS p
WHERE p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet%'
   OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet%'
GROUP BY
    p.party_type,
    p.statewide_vehicle_type,
    p.party_safety_equipment_1,
    p.party_safety_equipment_2
ORDER BY party_rows DESC
LIMIT 35

WITH helmet_values AS (
    SELECT p.case_id, p.party_type, p.statewide_vehicle_type,
           p.party_safety_equipment_1 AS equipment
    FROM main.parties AS p
    WHERE p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet%'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.case_id, p.party_type, p.statewide_vehicle_type,
           p.party_safety_equipment_2 AS equipment
    FROM main.parties AS p
    WHERE p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet%'
)
SELECT h.equipment, h.party_type, h.statewide_vehicle_type,
       COUNT(*) AS matched_codes,
       COUNT(DISTINCT h.case_id) AS collision_cases
FROM helmet_values AS h
JOIN main.collisions AS c ON c.case_id = h.case_id
WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
GROUP BY h.equipment, h.party_type, h.statewide_vehicle_type
ORDER BY h.equipment, matched_codes DESC

arguments.sql:
WITH helmet_status_by_collision AS (
    SELECT
        c.case_id,
        c.motorcyclist_killed_count,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN (
                'driver, motorcycle helmet used',
                'passenger, motorcycle helmet used'
            ) OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN (
                'driver, motorcycle helmet used',
                'passenger, motorcycle helmet used'
            ) THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS helmet_used,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN (
                'driver, motorcycle helmet not used',
                'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used'
            ) OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN (
                'driver, motorcycle helmet not used',
                'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used'
            ) THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS helmet_not_used
    FROM main.collisions AS c
    JOIN main.parties AS p ON p.case_id = c.case_id
    WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
      AND p.party_type IN ('driver', 'passenger')
    GROUP BY c.case_id, c.motorcyclist_killed_count
)
SELECT
    helmet_used,
    helmet_not_used,
    COUNT(*) AS collision_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT case_id) AS distinct_case_count,
    COUNT(motorcyclist_killed_count) AS known_fatality_counts,
    SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) AS motorcyclist_fatalities
FROM helmet_status_by_collision
GROUP BY helmet_used, helmet_not_used
ORDER BY helmet_used DESC, helmet_not_used DESC

WITH helmet_status_by_collision AS (
    SELECT
        c.case_id,
        c.motorcyclist_killed_count,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN (
                'driver, motorcycle helmet used',
                'passenger, motorcycle helmet used'
            ) OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN (
                'driver, motorcycle helmet used',
                'passenger, motorcycle helmet used'
            ) THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS helmet_used,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN (
                'driver, motorcycle helmet not used',
                'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used'
            ) OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN (
                'driver, motorcycle helmet not used',
                'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used'
            ) THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS helmet_not_used
    FROM main.collisions AS c
    JOIN main.parties AS p ON p.case_id = c.case_id
    WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
      AND p.party_type IN ('driver', 'passenger')
    GROUP BY c.case_id, c.motorcyclist_killed_count
)

        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE helmet_not_used = 1), 0)
